Vizhinjam Port to Commence Full EXIM Operations on August 18

The Vizhinjam International Seaport in Kerala is set to begin full Export-Import (EXIM) operations on August 18. This development is expected to significantly boost the state's trade capabilities and position it as a global trade gateway. The port's commencement of full operations marks a significant milestone for Kerala's economic infrastructure.
